shows.title: Trilogies: Triathlon
shows.description: This Friday and Saturday only: get 30% off with code TM261. WAXWING Productions returns to Culture Club with a three-week immersive theatre competition. Three directors develop three original immersive pieces, and each week the audience votes on which move forward. Three become two, and two become one final, full-length immersive experience. Catch this weekend's performances on Friday 11/27 and Saturday 11/28 and help decide which pieces advance. Offer expires Saturday 11/28.

shows.title: Twist of Fate
shows.description: It’s the 1980’s in the City of Angels, but performing one spiritual art could still land you in hot water. But no earthly law’s stopping this bold Romani Gypsy fortune-teller. Not only does she excel at the outlawed art of tarot reading, she’s determined to teach it to her rebellious teenage daughter. Unfortunately, the cards haven’t predicted the arrival of an undercover police officer.
